source.quote: SMSL's own page for the D-6, read 2026-11-24: « The second-generation XMOS solution supports sampling rate up to 32bit/768KHz and DSD512 »; « AK4493 chip, and carefully adjusted it to an unprecedented 0.00011% ».

_enriches_a_seed_record: This record existed from the seed import with family akm and a chip line reading « Two AK4493 (AKM), balanced output ». The maker's page says « AK4493 chip » in the singular and does not state a count. The seed's count is not contradicted here and not confirmed either; this claim adds the rates the seed lacked and leaves the count alone. It is also the record whose doubt notes no written reason for having no input block - it has one now.
